scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application (organizational tenant)

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application (platform tenant)

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Name of the environment for this application (ex: dev, factory, preprod or prod)

component.title: Component
component.description: Component name of this application (logical tenant)

app.title: App
app.description: Application name (functional tenant, default use Chart name)

version.title: Version
version.description: Version name of this application (default use Chart appVersion)

externalSecretDefaults.title: External Secret Defaults
externalSecretDefaults.description: Default settings of the ExternalSecret objects rendered by this chart when a secret is sourced from an external store (`externalSecret.enabled: true`). Requires the External Secrets Operator and a SecretStore/ClusterSecretStore.

apiVersion.title: Api Version
apiVersion.description: API version of the ExternalSecret CRD (external-secrets.io/v1beta1 for ESO releases without the v1 API)

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: How often the Secret is refreshed from the external store

secretStoreRef.title: Secret Store Ref
secretStoreRef.description: Store to read from (name is required as soon as a secret uses externalSecret)

operatorNamespace.title: Operator Namespace
operatorNamespace.description: Namespace hosting the Red Hat Loki operator (shared by every Red Hat operator installed in AllNamespaces mode)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the operator namespace. Keep it disabled when the cluster-config chart (`redhat.operators: true`) or another chart already manages the openshift-operators-redhat namespace

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the operator namespace (must match operator.subscription.namespace)

lokistack.title: Lokistack
lokistack.description: Deploy the LokiStack instance (the Loki log store used by the OpenShift Logging collector)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the LokiStack CR

hooked.title: Hooked
hooked.description: Activate the resource as a helm hook

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the LokiStack (the ClusterLogForwarder lokiStack output must reference this name)

size.title: Size
size.description: Deployment size, sets the replicas and resources of every Loki component (1x.demo for demo purpose only, 1x.pico, 1x.extra-small, 1x.small or 1x.medium)

storageClassName.title: Storage Class Name
storageClassName.description: Storage class used by the persistent volumes of the ingester, querier, ruler and compactor

managementState.title: Management State
managementState.description: Management state of the LokiStack (Managed or Unmanaged)

infra_enabled.title: Infra enabled
infra_enabled.description: Place every Loki component (compactor, distributor, gateway, indexGateway, ingester, querier, queryFrontend and ruler) on the infra nodes with the matching tolerations

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Tenancy mode of the gateway. openshift-logging is the mode used by the OpenShift Logging collector (application, infrastructure and audit tenants), openshift-network is the mode used by the Network Observability operator, static and dynamic are the generic OIDC/OPA modes

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Object storage configuration of the LokiStack

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: List of the storage schemas (version v11, v12 or v13 and the date it comes into effect). Add a new entry with a future effectiveDate to migrate an existing stack to a new schema

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Secret holding the object storage credentials, read by the Loki operator (see the storageSecret block to create it)

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the object storage secret (must exist in the LokiStack namespace)

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of the object storage provider (s3, azure, gcs, swift or alibabacloud)

credentialMode.title: Credential Mode
credentialMode.description: Credential mode of the object storage secret (static, token or token-cco). Empty keeps the operator default

tls.title: Tls
tls.description: TLS configuration used to reach the object storage endpoint (only rendered when caName is set)

caName.title: Ca Name
caName.description: Name of the ConfigMap (in the LokiStack namespace) holding the CA certificate of the object storage endpoint

caKey.title: Ca Key
caKey.description: Key of the CA certificate inside the ConfigMap (empty uses the operator default service-ca.crt)

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: Global retention of the logs stored in the LokiStack

days.title: Days
days.description: Number of days the logs are kept before deletion by the compactor (0 disables the retention policy, logs are never pruned)

streams.title: Streams
streams.description: List of per-stream retention rules ({days, priority, selector}), rendered only when days is set

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Global limits applied to every tenant of the LokiStack

ingestion.title: Ingestion
ingestion.description: Ingestion limits (raw map rendered under limits.global.ingestion, see the LokiStack CRD for the available fields)

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Query limits (raw map rendered under limits.global.queries, see the LokiStack CRD for the available fields)

replication.title: Replication
replication.description: Replication of the ingested data across the ingesters

factor.title: Factor
factor.description: Replication factor of the ingested data (0 keeps the default of the selected size)

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Configuration of the Loki ruler (evaluation of the AlertingRule and RecordingRule CRs)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the ruler component and the discovery of the rule CRs

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: Label selector of the AlertingRule and RecordingRule CRs evaluated by the ruler (empty selects every rule CR)

namespaceSelector.title: Namespace Selector
namespaceSelector.description: Label selector of the namespaces where the rule CRs are discovered (empty selects every namespace)

hashRing.title: Hash Ring
hashRing.description: Hash ring configuration of the Loki members (raw map rendered under spec.hashRing, empty keeps the operator default)

extraSpec.title: Extra Spec
extraSpec.description: Additional LokiStack spec fields appended as is at the end of the spec (raw map). Never repeat a field managed by the values above (size, storage, storageClassName, managementState, tenants, replication, limits, rules, hashRing or template when infra_enabled is true)

storageSecret.title: Storage Secret
storageSecret.description: Object storage secret read by the LokiStack (lokistack.storage.secret)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the object storage secret

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the secret (default is the lokistack.storage.secret.name value)

data.title: Data
data.description: Key/value pairs of the secret, rendered as stringData. The expected keys depend on the object storage provider (see https://github.com/openshift/loki/blob/release-6.6/operator/docs/lokistack/object_storage.md)

externalSecret.title: External Secret
externalSecret.description: Source this Secret from an external store instead of the data above: renders an ExternalSecret producing the same Secret (keys of your choice, see externalSecretDefaults)

secretStoreRef.title: Secret Store Ref
secretStoreRef.description: Store to read from (default is externalSecretDefaults.secretStoreRef)

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: How often the Secret is refreshed (default is externalSecretDefaults.refreshInterval)

remoteRefs.title: Remote Refs
remoteRefs.description: Map of the secret keys to the remote references ({key, property, version}) of the external store

data.title: Data
data.description: Raw ExternalSecret spec.data list (alternative to remoteRefs)

dataFrom.title: Data From
dataFrom.description: Raw ExternalSecret spec.dataFrom list, fetches every key of the external secret at once

alertingRules.title: Alerting Rules
alertingRules.description: Deploy AlertingRule CRs evaluated by the LokiStack ruler (requires lokistack.rules.enabled)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the AlertingRule CRs

list.title: List
list.description: List of the AlertingRule CRs to create

recordingRules.title: Recording Rules
recordingRules.description: Deploy RecordingRule CRs evaluated by the LokiStack ruler (requires lokistack.rules.enabled)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the RecordingRule CRs

list.title: List
list.description: List of the RecordingRule CRs to create

rulerConfig.title: Ruler Config
rulerConfig.description: Deploy the RulerConfig CR tuning the LokiStack ruler (evaluation intervals, Alertmanager and remote write)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the RulerConfig CR

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the RulerConfig (it is read by the LokiStack of the same namespace)

spec.title: Spec
spec.default:
evaluationInterval: 1m
pollInterval: 1m
